description: Main-window permissions for the ClipForge desktop app. The web UI is served by the local ClipForge server from http://127.0.0.1 (a remote origin for Tauri), so the capability must list that origin under `remote.urls` — a windows-only capability never applies to it, and with no capability at all every invoke from the UI is denied by the ACL. That was the 'no link opens' bug: the opener plugin's open_url command was denied, and window.open() is never routed to the browser by the WebView.
